provenance.notes: Against Qwen3.5 9B at 53.1 and Gemma 4 12B at 44.2 on the same table — a 3B beating models three and four times its size. Published with an arXiv technical report, which is more than most vendor claims on this site carry, but still the authors' own runs.

HMMT Feb 2026: 82.8. Extraordinary for 3B — higher than several 27B-class models here. Treat as a claim pending independent replication; a figure this far out of line with size is exactly what benchmark contamination looks like.
